propositions: Hard-coded corpus paths in plan_replay/__main__.py and ledger.py prevent client projects from supplying their own eval corpus and criteria
ledger.py imports genai_prices without guarding against the optional evals extra, causing import failures when the extra is not installed
provider_parity.py globs only packaged specs, so client-supplied .rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml specs never run
A single [llm.evals] corpus_root configuration option with CLI, env, file, and default precedence must govern all replay and ledger output paths
The new evals extra must be declared in EXTRAS and integrated into CI workflow tests
spec_paths union must include both packaged eval_specs and .rebar/evals project specs, with project specs winning on stem collision
